column1: # K-Line Dash: Nissan/Infiniti manufacturer-specific trouble code meanings
#   - description: our own short wording of the Nissan/Infiniti meaning of a P1xxx code.
#   - note: a short first check, only where sources widely agree; empty otherwise.
# Curated selection, not an import. A code is listed only if at least two independent publications agree
# on its meaning and none disagrees; codes where sources disagreed were left out.
# Sources (separate publications; all trace back to Nissan's engine-control diagnostic lists):
#   NM  Nissan EC section manuals of a 2003 Murano, 2005 Titan and 2008 Sentra (counted once)
#   ET  EcuTek GT-R and 370Z DTC lists (counted once)
#   TC  troublecodes.net, entries labelled Nissan/Infiniti: https://www.troublecodes.net/p1codes/
#   OC  obd-codes.com Nissan list (the Carvitas Nissan list is a copy, counted once)
#   TA  tat.net.au fault code database, Infiniti entries
# Meanings can differ by engine generation (P1126 is a thermostat code on older cars and a throttle motor
# relay code on newer ones); such codes were left out.
